thread:
dina: Heads-up: saw ECC error spike on pool-us-east-2-gpu3 starting ~1765432080. rate jumped to ~1200/min for ~20m, correlated to a few cards.
wayne: copying — linking ticket INC-4321. Any user impact?
dina: some increased tail latency on low-priority batch jobs, not full OOMs. saw repeated Xid 31 patterns on cards in node gpu3-14.
oncall-bot: Alert: ECC_RATE_SPIKE detected for pool-us-east-2-gpu3. severity=warning
maya: can we do a targeted quarantine of the noisy cards? trying to avoid full pool drains since prod throughput would slip under SLA.
samir: proposing a two-step approach: (1) bump soft-evict threshold temporarily, (2) run card-only quarantine (don't fully take host out of rotation), (3) run diagnostics.
wayne: what are the live thresholds? paste config snippet pls
dina: current config: `ecc.count.window=5m`, `soft_evict_rate=300/min`, `hard_evict_rate=1000/min`. spike hit ~1200/min.
dina: suggested temp change: `soft_evict_rate=600/min` for 30m then auto-revert. gives us breathing room to quarantine without bulk host churn.
maya: +1 if infra approves. also want a reroute for low-priority batch to APAC for the window to protect user-facing SLOs.
wayne: I'm ok with the temp raise if we add an audit entry and a short playbook for rollback. I'll patch the runbook and own the audit.
samir: I'll start canary quarantine on nodes gpu3-14 and gpu3-15 — cards only. Runbook snippet:
```
- mark specific PCI slots as quarantined
- reroute new tasks off those cards
- let existing tasks drain for 10m
- collect ECC/Xid histograms every 30s
- if error rate falls < 10% baseline -> unquarantine
```
ops-bot: Quarantine job started for gpu3-14 at 1765432130 (job id q-8834)
maya: note: cross-region shift increases egress & infra cost — approve for up to 2 hours only.
wayne: cost tradeoff noted. set hard cap $2k for the window; auto-revert routing if exceeded.
dina: will add `ecc_etl` tag to logs and a spike-alert to PagerDuty if persists > 1h. updating INC-4321 with timeline.
samir: after quarantine run full GPU diag: `nvml-scan --extended --pci gpu3-14` and if correctable ECC counts don't drop >=90% in 24h, schedule replacement.
wayne: add a short-lived metric for Xid-repeat patterns so we don't misfire on transient bursts.
maya: sounds good. please post status update in 10m and when quarantine completes. thanks team :thumbsup:
